retrieved_synopses: Karlach reacts to Wyll being sent to hell.

Post EADialogue with Wyll after Druid Attack. In most cases, this will involve him training a tiefling child before the player breaks in, and you discover you were both on the mind flayer ship. Wyll comes across as a big-time hero, and wants help killing goblins. He is called the Blade of Frontiers by most.
After meeting Karlach and choosing whether to keep her alive or kill her, Mizora appears in camp to turn Wyll into a devil or reward him with a new power.
Karlach reacts to Wyll's OM confronting her.

Default Ravengard dialogue. Depending on the path, Ravengard may urge you to save the city, and if Wyll is in party, will offer the quest to go to the Wyrmway. Wyll's endgame state is detremined here: He may become a Duke, the Blade of Avernus, or remain the Blade of Frontiers
context: Karlach is reacting to a recent, fraught decision: during Mizora’s judgement in camp, Wyll refused to kill her and instead accepted a terrible bargain to be transformed into a devil in her stead. She’s stunned and deeply grateful, struggling to express how to repay him for sticking his neck out. The player and Wyll are party members here — the player’s replies range from sincere relief to teasing offers of future help. This exchange sits against larger story branches where Wyll’s fate (heroic renown, damnation, or something between) depends on earlier choices.
